description: Fixed, deterministic subset of evaluations/ragas/cases.json used for the OPT-IN paid RAGAS LLM-judge run (Phase 7E). Kept small (24 cases) and STABLE so paid runs are comparable across commits. Covers role/skills/technology/education, US+UK+Germany compensation, labour market + shortage, transition, digital competency, cybersecurity, seniority, mixed, and safety (insufficient-evidence) cases. Do NOT randomise; edit deliberately.
